title: Royal Bank of Canada Corporate 13.1
description: Royal Bank of Canada Corporate 13.1 is the corporate race in the Royal Parks Half Marathon presented by Royal Bank of Canada.  Teams are made up of 4-7 runners and can compete for trophies for the Fastest Male, Female and Mixed Teams.  We encourage all teams to make every step count by raising funds for your preferred charity.   Corporate entry provides companies with: - Guaranteed places in this sell-out event - 16,000 runners  Chance to race on a Central London route - for you and your employees - Your company logo featured on our website – over 1.5m page views a year - A platform to fundraise for your company's charity of the year - An opportunity to get the whole team involved – a half marathon is an epic challenge, and your company team(s) could do with some vocal support.    Click here to find out more about our corporate challenge https://royalparkshalf.com/royalbankofcanada-corporate-131/
